events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis' iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' was released on August 29, 1994, becoming the fastest-selling debut album in British history.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe legacy
angles.copy: 32 years ago today, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. What's your go-to track from this Britpop masterpiece?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, attracting nearly half a million people to Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock vibe
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and magic of Woodstock began. If you could have been there, which artist would you have loved to see?

events.title: Elvis Presley's 49th Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: 49 years today since we lost the one and only King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's 56th Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix tribute
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible legacy of Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 56 years gone this month. His guitar work truly changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969, in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road iconic cover
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road' and that legendary zebra crossing shot. What's your favourite track from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to the formidable Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde celebration
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the iconic frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, Liam Gallagher, born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher birthday shoutout
angles.copy: Our kid's 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite tune featuring his legendary vocals?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK single anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's enduring message
angles.copy: 'Imagine all the people, living life in peace...' John Lennon's powerful anthem 'Imagine' saw its UK single release today in 1975. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod launched 25 years ago today, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket'. How many did you fill yours with?

events.title: James Bond Day 2026
events.blurb: It's James Bond Day, celebrating the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your ultimate 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the enduring genius of John Lennon. What's your favourite Beatles or solo track by him?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary actor, comedian, and writer, John Cleese, born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese celebration
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedic genius, John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album deep dive
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' – a sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. What hidden gems do you love on this double LP?
